_meta.description: Armor Class x Tier. 5 classes (Titan/Hellforge/Tempest/Echo/Expedition), 4 tiers (no Uncommon, no Mythic). Read by ArmorBase/ArmorTier via GameManager.data['armor'].
_meta.status: SECOND-PASS BALANCED (2026-07-31) — the 2026-07-06 buff was reverted and re-derived: it had made high-tier armor grant literal IMMUNITY to several weapons. Still testable/pending playtesting, not locked final.
_meta._balanced: 2026-07-05 first-pass; 2026-07-06 buff; 2026-07-31 second pass — testable values pending playtesting
_meta._tbd: 2026-07-31 flat_reduction cut hard (Common 4->1, Rare 7->2, Epic 11->3, Legendary 16->4) and percent_reduction rebalanced (0.15/0.28/0.42/0.58 -> 0.10/0.18/0.26/0.34). Still placeholder pending playtest, NOT locked final.
_meta._critical_fix_2026_07_31: THE 2026-07-06 VALUES CREATED HARD IMMUNITY. PlayerStats.take_damage() computes maxf(amount - flat_reduction, 0.0). Legendary flat was 16, and Titan's Bulwark passive added 3 more = 19. Weapon per-hit damage at Common is Daggers 9 / Spears 15 / Swords 17 — ALL below 19, so a Legendary Titan wearer took EXACTLY ZERO damage from three of the five weapon classes, and even a Legendary Dagger (13.5) could not scratch them. The wearer could only be killed by Hammers/Axes or by environmental damage (which bypasses armor entirely). INVARIANT GOING FORWARD: max total flat (highest tier flat + Titan bonus_flat_reduction) must stay STRICTLY BELOW the lowest per-hit weapon damage in weapon_stats.json (Daggers Common 9.0). Current max total is 4 + 2 = 6. Mitigation is now carried mostly by percent_reduction, which scales with hit size and can never zero a hit.

schema.tiers.<Tier>.durability: hits absorbed before the armor breaks; degrades 1 per hit
schema.passive.<param>: class-unique passive strength — now filled with first-pass balanced value

_meta.tier_curve_note: Tier stats are identical across all 5 classes (monotonic Common<Rare<Epic<Legendary); class identity comes from the passive. Player has 100 HP; pipeline is armor flat -> armor percent -> durability -> Toughness relic -> HP.
_meta._balance_note: Total mitigation against a Swords Common hit (17 dmg): Common 15% | Rare 28% | Epic 39% | Legendary 50%. Was 15% / 33% / 63% / 97.5% — Legendary now halves a hit instead of erasing it. Sword-vs-Legendary TTK on a 100-HP target moves from ~159s (unwinnable) to ~7.8s. Tier jumps are still clearly felt but no longer decide fights on their own.
_meta._durability_note: Durability 40/65/90/120 (was 40/75/120/180). Legendary cut because 180 x Expedition's 1.5 mult = 270 hits, longer than any realistic 18-22 min match, making top-tier armor effectively permanent. Common deliberately unchanged — the flagged problem was the top of the curve, not the bottom. Tier ratio tightened from 4.5x to 3.0x.

passive.name: Bulwark
passive._desc: extra flat reduction on top of tier flat
passive._note_2026_07_31: 3 -> 2. Stacks on top of tier flat, so it sets the game's maximum total flat (Legendary 4 + 2 = 6). Kept strictly below Daggers Common 9.0 so Titan can never be immune to any weapon — see _critical_fix_2026_07_31.
